{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "result": {"tools": [{"name": "search_policy_documents", "description": "Return the policy clause(s) that cover the event and limit the caller
asks about, so the caller can answer a coverage question from policy
language instead of from memory.

WHEN to call: any question about what a policy covers, excludes, pays, or
caps (coverage limits, deductibles, covered perils, excluded events).

HOW to shape the query: name the covered EVENT and the LIMIT you need,
using the policy's own words. The policy speaks of water-ingress loss as
"flood" under Endorsement W, so query terms like "flood", "flood
insurance limit", or "Endorsement W" are what match — "water damage"
alone does not appear in the corpus.

ON a recoverable error: read the error, it names the policy vocabulary;
re-run ONCE with the corrected query. If even a query that names the
policy term returns no match, report 'not covered under this policy'
rather than inventing a figure.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string", "description": "What to look up, e.g. the covered event or limit."}}, "required": ["query"]}}, {"name": "get_policy", "description": "Return the policy record for one policy number, POL-YYYY-nnnnn.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"policy_number": {"type": "string", "description": "The policy number, e.g. 'POL-2024-88120'."}}, "required": ["policy_number"]}}, {"name": "claim_status", "description": "Look up the current status of an insurance claim by claim number (CLM-YYYY-nnnnn): claimant, linked policy, status, reported date and claimed amount. Read-only.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"claim_number": {"type": "string", "description": "The claim number, e.g. 'CLM-2024-88120'."}}, "required": ["claim_number"]}}, {"name": "claim_adjuster_notes", "description": "Read the adjuster's note history for one insurance claim by claim number (CLM-YYYY-nnnnn). Sensitive: notes may name claimants and their address/damage details. Read-only.", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"claim_number": {"type": "string", "description": "The claim number, e.g. 'CLM-2024-88120'."}}, "required": ["claim_number"]}}]}}

{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 4, "result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "{\"error\": \"denied: the scoped token you presented (scope 'ro') does not include claim_adjuster_notes.
